acip: RTZA BAR 'DOD NA, SPYI CHOS CAN, RTAG PA'I BYE BRAG YIN PAR THAL, KHYOD RTAG PA YIN, KHYOD RTAG PA DANG BDAG GCIG TU 'BREL, KHYOD MA YIN ZHING RTAG PA YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN DU MA GRUB PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: rtsa bar 'dod na, spyi chos can, rtag pa'i bye brag yin par thal, khyod rtag pa yin, khyod rtag pa dang bdag gcig tu 'brel, khyod ma yin zhing rtag pa yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun du ma grub pa'i phyir
english: [Then I agree with your original statement: "quality" is never characteristic of the quality "unchanging thing."] Suppose you agree with our original statement, [saying that "quality" is never characteristic of the quality "unchanging thing"]. Consider "quality." It is so characteristic of the quality "unchanging thing," Because (1) it is an unchanging thing; (2) it has a relationship with "unchanging thing" such that to be "quality" is to automatically be an unchanging thing; and (3) there exist multiple things which are both not "quality," but still an unchanging thing. *************
